scope: Independent whole-gameplan challenge of candidate selection, target-host acceptance, SQL lifecycle repair, inactive Lean model boundaries, documentation cleanup and commercial gates. All 91 R2 inputs were byte-checked; substantive inspection concentrated on the contract, runtime plan, human plan, model/types/claims/audit/verifier/config, prior rejected-reuse reviews and disposition, current evidence index, cleanup receipt, latency/lifecycle basis and relevant current worker/SQL/benchmark source. APPROVE_GAMEPLAN authorizes only this planning scope, not a selected worker implementation or a mechanically VERIFIED closure.
assessment: FRESH, PRESTART and REUSE have distinct experiments and rejection conditions. Prestart remains one-use and accounts for empty-pool/refill/retirement costs. True reuse cannot be selected on loader close, GC, reset flags or finite differential agreement alone; concrete reached-state, resource and ownership audits remain required. The former six-seat rejection is preserved.

The dependency order closes missing baseline checks, repairs owned database cleanup and profiles the complete constrained path before worker selection. Fixed nonzero SQL deadline forms and all observation/control SQL require a separate SQLeanParser policy amendment. Cleanup uncertainty retains admission ownership rather than manufacturing capacity.

The 4-vCPU/8-GiB acceptance host is distinguished from synthetic workstation quotas. Whole-stack accounting, a 6-GiB ceiling/5-GiB peak criterion, three independently passing original 100/1000 runs, cold cycles, open-loop sustained load, overload tests and finite resource soak give actionable future acceptance conditions without claiming a measured result.

The 32 propositions describe a guarded single-use abstract model. Database termination, process containment, true reuse, hardware timing and implementation refinement are explicitly excluded. The read-only source_inventory check passed for all 32 declarations; the expected exact type/axiom text matches author-type-audit.log, and the active formal import excludes PerformancePlan. These are inventory checks, not fresh Lean build evidence.

Documentation cleanup preserves historical evidence and identifies the prior whole-source manifest as historical. Commercialization remains NO_GO until independent technical, rights, consenting-pilot and support-economics gates close.

R2 resolves the documentation ambiguity: existing 32-proposition/two-build evidence is explicitly author development evidence, and future registered closure remains separate from both this council vote and implementation acceptance.
limitations: No SQL, browser, HTTP, new runtime experiment or Lean clean build was executed. The author development-check is not registered final model closure.

Approval does not establish an immutable-image adapter, classloader reset, PostgreSQL cancellation, bounded real process topology, target p95, redistribution permission or commercial readiness. Those remain the concrete future gates required by the contract.
